name: best-of-n
notes: Best-of-N (T3): three attempts on different platforms; Jev ranks the ones that finished, asked in two option orders, and forwards the winner only when it leads clearly (else the top two go to you); a person merges it. Attempts write to their own folders (candidates/attempt-N/); a parallel code change needs its own git worktree, which this template does not create.

nodes.task:
{goal}
